record.one_liner: SendGrid provides a v3 REST API and email infrastructure for transactional and marketing emails, authenticated via API keys.

auth_methods.quote: To authenticate access to Twilio SendGrid services, use Application Programming Interface (API) keys.

access_test.quote: Free trial No credit card required

access_ship.quote: Flexible pricing Same email solutions, new home base.

api_type.quote: The SendGrid v3 Web API provides a REST interface to send email at scale and ensure your application can handle high volumes.

api_breadth.quote: The SendGrid API endpoints allow you to integrate with your tech stack to send transactional emails, create marketing campaigns, manage your contacts, and monitor the health of your email statistics.
